title: Find Single Unique Element
problem: Given a non-empty array of integers where every element appears twice except for one, find that single one.
constraints:
1 <= nums.length <= 3 * 10^4
-3 * 10^4 <= nums[i] <= 3 * 10^4
Each element in the array appears twice except for one element.
hints: XOR of a number with itself is 0.
XOR of any number with 0 is the number itself.
expected_approach: XOR all elements in the array to find the single element.
